name: @game-hub/bench
description: Bot-strength bench harness (dev tool, not shipped): plays every game's built-in policy against itself over N seeded games and prints the win rate with a Wilson 95% CI. Depends on the four game packages' ./bot exports + @game-hub/kernel/bot. Run via `pnpm bench` (or `pnpm --filter @game-hub/bench bench`).
